vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, clear, highly organized

fonts.usage: H1-H4, large metric numbers, section titles
Paragraphs, navigation links, secondary text, timestamps

layout_and_spacing.strategy: High density, clear data correlation, functional scanning.

surfaces.style: Flat solid surfaces. 1px solid border. Very subtle shadows only on hover.

navigation_menu.style: Vertical collapsible (or visually distinct) sidebar. Active state highlighted with primary brand color background (10% opacity) and left border stroke (3px). Hover states explicitly define background and text color.

cards.default: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-4

buttons.primary: bg-primary_brand text-white font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:bg-opacity-90 transition-colors
buttons.quick_action: flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl hover:border-primary_brand hover:text-primary_brand transition-all

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle border color shifts, 1px lift for interactive cards.

media_urls.description: Professional user portrait for sidebar profile
Minimalist geometric background for subtle data visualizations or empty states

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Examples: data-testid='sidebar-notes-link', data-testid='quick-action-timer', data-testid='theme-toggle-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write components in .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx (TypeScript is not used).
Build a persistent left sidebar layout (`w-64`) on desktop, collapsing to a bottom tab or hamburger on mobile.
Group the sidebar links explicitly under uppercase overlines: 'CREATE' (Notes, Planner, Practice), 'TRACK' (Goals, Timer), 'REVIEW' (History, Analytics).
Replace the flat homepage with a dashboard layout using a bento-style 'Control Room' grid (grid-cols-4).
Include a 'Quick Actions' row at the top of the dashboard (e.g., 'New Note', 'Start Timer', 'Log Practice').
Include 3-4 Metric Cards (e.g., 'Study Time', 'Current Streak', 'Tasks Completed').
Include an 'Active Goals' section with progress bars (Shadcn Progress component).
Include a 'Recent Activity' timeline or list on the right side of the dashboard grid.
Place the user avatar, logout button, and theme toggle fixed at the bottom of the sidebar.
Use standard Shadcn components for Cards, Buttons, Avatars, Progress, and Badges.
Ensure the design remains strictly within Archetype 4: clean, highly functional, 1px borders, minimal shadows, high data clarity.
ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid='dashboard-new-note-btn').
